note: partcl (Serge Zaitsev), a minimal Tcl interpreter in portable C (set/proc/if/while, command substitution, prefix arithmetic), cross-compiled to a 16-bit MS-DOS MZ .EXE with ia16-elf-gcc. It is DOS-NATIVE: it runs on the bw-board 8086 DOS service bench, reads PROG.TCL via INT 21h, and prints via the C library. Packaged as media-lab project projects/tcl-dos (fetch.sh reproduces this byte-for-byte). Build tool ia16-elf-gcc is GPL but build-time only; the binary links permissive newlib + libi86.
